as_told.title: Cracked egg with sphere inside taken to Berkeley labs

plain: In 1948, a man named Albert Bruce Collins is said to have seen a lowboy trailer, a long, low flatbed for heavy loads, at the University of California, Berkeley, carrying a recovered craft. The online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb passes on Collins's account, drawing on Leonard Stringfield and Tim Cooper, as evidence that crashed craft were quietly handed to universities for study. Michels tells a version of the same story from Michael Schratt and Stringfield: an egg-shaped craft, cracked, with a sphere inside, taken to the Berkeley labs to be studied. He gives no date and does not name Collins.
